briefTitle: Beamion LUNG-3: Adjuvant Zongertinib vs Standard Treatment in People With Completely Resected Stage II-IIIB NSCLC Harboring Activating HER2 TKD Mutations

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients must be ≥18 years old or over the legal age of consent in their country
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients must be ≥18 years old or over the legal age of consent in their country

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0 or 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0 or 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Documented Tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) activating Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) mutations
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no typed kind for HER2 variants.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosis of NSCLC with mixed histology/positive neuroendocrine markers (synaptophysin/CD56)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Mixed histology and neuroendocrine markers are not standard single histology inclusion/exclusion codes.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery (major according to the investigator's assessment) performed within 4 weeks prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator assessment makes this judgment-based.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Co-occurring actionable mutation with approved targeted therapy (e.g. Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) or Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK))
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General co-occurring actionable mutation exclusion is not a single typed gene status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Signed and dated written informed consent in accordance with ICH-GCP and local legislation prior to admission to the trial
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent is a standard administrative requirement rather than a clinical eligibility check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must be ready and able to use dual highly effective methods of birth control
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance is a behavioral requirement, not a typed clinical status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HER2 mutation: Documented Tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) activating Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) mutations
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no typed kind for HER2 variants.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of primary NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General NSCLC histology confirmation without specific subtype list is not a typed histology check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: An archival tumor tissue sample must be submitted to the central laboratory after inclusion of the patient to retrospectively confirm the HER2 status
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tissue submission requirement is a procedural rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate organ function based on laboratory values Further inclusion criteria apply.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function without specific lab cutoffs is subjective or incomplete.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosis of NSCLC with mixed histology/positive neuroendocrine markers (synaptophysin/CD56)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion for mixed histology or neuroendocrine markers does not map to standard typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery (major according to the investigator's assessment) performed within 4 weeks prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires investigator assessment of major surgery and a complex washout window.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with radiation therapy for primary NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiation treatment exclusion does not fit a standard typed prior therapy exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Co-occurring actionable mutation with approved targeted therapy (e.g. Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) or Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK))
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Co-occurring actionable mutation exclusion involves multiple possible genes and is not a single simple typed mutation exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any investigational drug within 5 half-lives of the compound or any of its related material, if known
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window based on half-lives is not a fixed date or simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active or known pre-existing or history of non-infectious interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis Active infectious disease requiring systemic therapy Uncontrolled gastrointestinal disorders affecting drug intake/absorption Previous or concomitant malignancies within the last 3 years, except certain effectively treated cancers Significant and/or uncontrolled cardiovascular abnormalities, QT interval corrected for heart rate by Fridericia formula (QTcF) >470 msec, or ejection fraction <50%
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex multi-system medical history and specialized cardiac parameter exclusions (QTcF, ejection fraction) do not have matching typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Staging: Pretherapeutic classification not exceeding Stage IIIB
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: deterministic normalizer did not verify this model check
